items.name_mm: ကိုရီးယား ထမင်းသုပ်
items.description: Bibimbap (/ˈbiːbɪmbæp/ BEE-bim-bap; Korean: 비빔밥; lit. 'mixed rice'), sometimes romanised as bi bim bap or bi bim bop, is a Korean rice dish. It is served as a bowl of warm white rice topped with namul (sautéed or blanched seasoned vegetables) and gochujang (chili pepper paste). Egg and sliced meat (usually beef) are common additions, stirred together thoroughly just before eating. The term bibim means "mixing" and bap is cooked rice.
items.name_th: บิบิมบับเกาหลี
items.description_th: บิบิมบับ (/ˈbiːbɪmbæp/ BEE-bim-bap; เกาหลี: 비빔밥; มีความหมายว่า 'ข้าวผสม') บางครั้งเรียกเป็นภาษาเกาหลีว่า บิบิมบับ หรือ บิบิมบอป
items.description_cn: Bibimbap（/ˈbiːbɪmbæp/ BEE-bim-bap；韩语：비빔밥；字面意思是“混合米饭”），有时罗马字为 bi bim bap 或 bi bim bop，是一种韩国米饭菜肴。
items.description_ru: Пибимбап (/ˈbiːbɪmbæp/ BEE-bim-bap; корейский: 비빔밥; букв. «рисовая смесь»), иногда романизируемый как би бим бап или би бим боп, — корейское блюдо из риса.
items.description_ja: ビビンバ (/ˈbiːbɪmbæp/ BEE-bim-bap、韓国語: 비빔밥、文字通り「混ぜご飯」) は、ローマ字で bi bim bap または bi bim bop とも呼ばれ、韓国の米料理です。
items.description_ko: 비빔밥(/ˈbiːbəmbæp/ BEE-bim-bap; 한국어: 비빔밥; lit. 'mixed rice')은 때때로 비빔밥 또는 비빔밥으로 로마자로 표기되는 한국 쌀 요리입니다.
items.description_fr: Bibimbap (/ˈbiːbɪmbæp/ BEE-bim-bap ; coréen : 비빔밥 ; lit. 'riz mélangé'), parfois romanisé comme bi bim bap ou bi bim bop, est un plat de riz coréen.
items.description_de: Bibimbap (/ˈbiːbɪmbæp/ BEE-bim-bap; Koreanisch: 비빔밥; wörtlich „gemischter Reis“), manchmal romanisiert als bi bim bap oder bi bim bop, ist ein koreanisches Reisgericht.
items.description_hi: बिबिंबैप (/ˈbiːbɪmbæp/ BEE-bim-bap; कोरियाई: 비빔밥; शाब्दिक रूप से 'मिश्रित चावल'), जिसे कभी-कभी बि बिम बाप या बि बिम बोप के रूप में रोमन किया जाता है, एक कोरियाई चावल का व्यंजन है।
items.description_ar: بيبيمباب (/ˈbiːbɪmbæp/ BEE-bim-bap; الكورية: 비빔밥; مضاءة. "أرز مختلط")، مكتوب بالحروف اللاتينية أحيانًا باسم بي بيم باب أو بي بيم بوب، هو طبق أرز كوري.

items.name: Kyay Oh (Pork)
items.description: Kyay oh is a popular noodle soup made with pork and egg in Burmese cuisine. Fish and chicken versions are also made as well as a "dry" version without broth. Kyay oh is made with rice noodles (rice vermicelli or flat rice noodles) and marinated meatballs. The broth is made with pork, chicken, or fish. The pork version, the most popular, uses pork bones and intestine. Kyay oh is typically served with a tomato and green pepper sauce.
